crossRefs.note: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with…

translations.web: “They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.
translations.bsb: They are to make the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.
translations.kjv: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.
translations.asv: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skilful workman.
